notas: La música de cama es la pista de práctica de Jingle Bells que viene con el producto (nuestra, sin Content ID): el video suena a lo que se compra.

escenas.dice: Can't read music? You can still play Jingle Bells tonight.
Every note has its letter printed inside, so you find that key and press it.
A keyboard guide shows where every letter sits.
Twenty traditional carols, from Silent Night to Carol of the Bells.
Each song has an MP3, so you can hear how it goes before you play.
And a Spanish edition with Do Re Mi note names.

cierre.dice: Easy Christmas Piano Sheet Music. It's on Etsy, link in the description.

youtube.titulo: Easy Christmas Piano Sheet Music with Letter Notes: 20 carols flip-through
youtube.descripcion:
Easy Christmas piano sheet music for beginners: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4605991888

20 traditional carols with the note name printed inside every note, so you find the key and play. Right hand plays the melody, the left hand one low note per chord. A keyboard guide shows where each letter is, and every song has an MP3 practice track so you can hear it first. The music in this video is the Jingle Bells track from the book.

Printable PDF, US Letter or A4. Spanish edition with Do Re Mi note names included. SheetSmithChile on Etsy.
